hero.title: Welcome home, alumni.
hero.subtitle: Reconnect with your batch, support today's students and join the next reunion.

vision: To keep every alumnus connected, and every student who follows us supported.

join.title: Your batch is already here.
join.body: Sign up with your passing year to find your batchmates.

faq.question: Who can join?
faq.answer: Anyone who studied at the school, from any batch, and its present and former faculty. Choose your passing year when you sign up.

faq.question: Is membership free?
faq.answer: Yes. Joining the network, the member directory, events and stories cost nothing. Donations are always optional.

faq.question: How is my account verified?
faq.answer: An office bearer checks your name and batch and approves you, usually within a few days.

faq.question: Who can see my contact details?
faq.answer: Only signed-in, verified members. You can mark your profile confidential to hide them.

faq.question: How can I help?
faq.answer: Mentor a student, volunteer for your batch, post a job for the network, or write a story about your school days.

giving.title: Pay it forward.
giving.body: Alumni fund scholarships, mentoring and campus projects.
